name: CGOV
description_short: Governance dashboard for proposals and voting.
description_long: An open-source Cardano governance platform for monitoring, tracking, and participating in on-chain governance. Covers all governance action types with live vote tallies, bubble-map and voting-trend visualizations, and exportable voting records (JSON/CSV/Markdown); DRep dashboards with profiles, voting power and voting history; treasury tracking including Net Change Limit (NCL) monitoring; and an AI assistant backed by an open MCP server. Built by Nomos Guild, a joint governance initiative of MeshJS and SIDAN Lab.
